units.source_text: 在薄暮中，桥那边的山峦已经是一片白茫茫的景色。

en.t: In the dusk, the mountains beyond the bridge had already become a vast white scene.

units.source_text: 在这北国，每到落叶飘零、寒风萧瑟的时节，天空老是冷飕飕，阴沉沉的。

en.t: In this northern country, whenever the leaves fall and the cold wind turns bleak, the sky is always chilly and overcast.
That meant snow was about to fall.

units.source_text: 远近的高山都变成一片茫茫的白色，这叫做“云雾环岳”。

en.t: The high mountains near and far all turned into a vast expanse of white; this was called "clouds and mist encircling the peaks."

units.source_text: 另外，近海处可以听见海在呼啸，深山中可以听到山在呜咽，这自然的交响犹如远处传来的闷雷，这叫做“海吼山鸣”。

en.t: Also, near the sea one could hear the sea roaring, and deep in the mountains one could hear the mountains moaning; this natural symphony sounded like muffled thunder from far away, and was called "the sea roaring and the mountains sounding."

units.source_text: 看到“云雾环岳”，听见“海吼山鸣”，就知道快要下雪了。

en.t: When one saw "clouds and mist encircling the peaks" and heard "the sea roaring and the mountains sounding," one knew that snow would soon fall.

units.source_text: 岛村想起古书上有过这样的记载。

en.t: Shimamura remembered that old books had recorded something like this.
